method: Actual source functions transpiled by the locked project TypeScript compiler. In-memory Firestore mock enforces all reads before writes, atomic commit, and optimistic contention retries. No production Firebase access.

results.name: Concurrent order increments preserve all portions
Order retry with same operation ID does not add twice
Reusing order operation ID for different content is rejected
Kitchen does not erase a newly added order
Stale quantity edit conflicts rather than overwrites
Failed merge preserves source and destination atomically
Merge moves each order once and replay is harmless
Transfer rejects a destination occupied on the server
Concurrent imports preserve stock, receipts, and cards
An import cash-write failure leaves no partial inventory change
Import retry is idempotent
Inventory precision retains 0.95 + 0.1 = 1.05
Audit refuses stale stock and leaves no audit/card
Manual cash replay increments totals only once
Manual cash and imports reject a closed shift
Cancellation reverses the original shift and exact stock movements
Cancelling an aggregate without invoice coverage creates no negative total
Cancellation of an untracked new invoice does not invent stock
Checkout uses the server shift state and preserves the order on rejection
Checkout keeps committed success when a post-commit availability update fails
Checkout persists exact stock deltas and a server cost snapshot
Checkout rejects unsaved draft sessions
Price, discount, and VAT are computed once from item subtotals
Estimated invoice costs remain estimated in source aggregates
Daily expense amounts are not divided by 30 in the financial view
Multiple attendance sessions count one workday and only actual hours
Complete source calculations retain more than 100/300 documents
Source recomputation removes a cancelled cached invoice and its cost
Cached/offline source data is not marked reconciled
Cash form keeps entered data after a rejected server write
Vietnam date boundaries retain invoices around UTC midnight
Recipe versions are not merged by a shared dish ID
Backfill skips a day changed by a concurrent historical cancellation
Backfill resets an empty historical day rather than preserving stale revenue
Backfill dry-run does not write any aggregates
Migration job lock has one owner and cannot be released by another job
Date-range subscription includes old/new schemas, without display limits
Missing-index fallback has no truncation and unsubscribe ignores late responses
Receipt reconciliation detects duplicate and missing sale receipts
Cross-store operations are rejected before changing inventory
Two kitchen devices completing different lines preserve both changes
Adding portions to a completed line creates a new pending line
Cancellation replay never restores stock twice
Concurrent attendance scans open only one session
Explicit check-out closes an overnight open session without creating another day
Explicit check-out without a check-in cannot invent a work session
Per-item revenue includes add-ons and allocates whole-dong discounts exactly
Free inventory imports still update weighted average cost
Unavailable source costs remain estimated even if an old order has a price
Two devices opening a shift share one guarded open shift
Order cloning supports the existing iOS 15 target without structuredClone
